_source: Distilled from the offline ER guide (itself distilled from eldenring.wiki.gg CC BY-SA + Fextralife, reworded). Spoiler-light: functional steps + fail triggers, story kept to one-liners. '(verify)' marks community claims not re-confirmed in-game.
generalRules: After every demigod or region boss, return to Roundtable Hold and talk to everyone until their lines repeat.
Exhaust dialogue at every meeting before moving on — many steps only advance once lines repeat.
Many hand-offs need a rest + reload at a Site of Grace to register.
When unsure, do quest steps BEFORE clearing that region's main boss.
Point of no return: beating Maliketh in Crumbling Farum Azula changes the world — wrap up quests first.

quests.name: Ranni the Witch
quests.tagline: The big one — a top-tier weapon plus the Age of the Stars ending.
quests.reward: Dark Moon Greatsword · unlocks the Age of the Stars ending

steps.text: Rest at the Church of Elleh (Limgrave) after getting Torrent; talk to Renna on the wall for the Spirit Calling Bell + Lone Wolf Ashes.
Go to Ranni's Rise (above Caria Manor, NW Liurnia). Accept her service, speak to the projections of Iji, Blaidd and Seluvis below, then return to Ranni.
Beat Starscourge Radahn (Caelid) — this opens Nokron, Eternal City via the chasm in southern Mistwood.
In Nokron, grab the Fingerslayer Blade from the chest NE of the Night's Sacred Ground grace.
Give the blade to Ranni → Renna's Rise opens next door. Take the Miniature Ranni doll inside and talk to it three times at the Ainsel River Main grace.
Push through Ainsel River past Nokstella, beat the Baleful Shadow, and take the Discarded Palace Key.
Open the chest in Rennala's boss room (Raya Lucaria) with the key → Dark Moon Ring.
Cross the Lake of Rot, beat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, and ride to the Moonlight Altar (SW Liurnia).
In the Cathedral of Manus Celes, equip the Dark Moon Ring near Ranni → receive the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Ending: after the final boss, summon Ranni's blue sign for Age of the Stars.

warnings: NEVER give Ranni "Seluvis's Potion" (the Amber Draught) — instant, permanent break.
Don't kill Iji (the giant smith below Caria Manor) or Blaidd early — both are needed.
The Seluvis sub-quest is optional and risky; you can ignore Seluvis entirely and Ranni still completes.

quests.name: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
quests.tagline: Ranni's sworn blade — runs alongside her quest.
quests.reward: Royal Greatsword + Blaidd's armor set

steps.text: Hear howling at Mistwood Ruins (E Limgrave). Learn the Finger Snap gesture from Kalé at the Church of Elleh, use it near the tower to call Blaidd down.
Help him beat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil at the Forlorn Hound Evergaol (S Limgrave), then talk to him there.
After starting Ranni's quest, meet him again in Siofra River.
He fights beside you at the Radahn Festival and marks the way to Nokron.
Late in Ranni's quest he turns hostile at Ranni's Rise — defeat him for his armor and the Royal Greatsword.

warnings: Don't kill Blaidd early; exhaust his dialogue at every stop, including at Darriwil's evergaol.

quests.name: Roderika
quests.tagline: Becomes the Spirit Tuner who upgrades your Spirit Ashes.
quests.reward: Spirit Ash upgrading unlocked · Spirit Jellyfish Ashes

steps.text: Talk to her at Stormhill Shack (before Margit) until lines repeat → Spirit Jellyfish Ashes + a gesture.
Find the Chrysalids' Memento in Stormveil Castle and bring it to her.
At Roundtable Hold, talk to smith Hewg about her, then talk to her again → she becomes the Spirit Tuner.

warnings: Beat Godrick or rest in Liurnia before meeting her at the shack and she skips ahead — you keep the tuner but lose the early rewards. Visit the shack first.

quests.name: Sorcerer Rogier
quests.tagline: His research points you at Ranni and feeds Fia's quest.
quests.reward: Rogier's Rapier + spellblade gear · unlocks Fia's next stage

steps.text: Meet him in the Stormveil Castle chapel (he's also a gold summon vs Margit/Godrick). Exhaust dialogue → he moves to Roundtable Hold.
After beating Godrick, ask about the corpse beneath the castle.
Bring him the Black Knifeprint from Black Knife Catacombs (NE Liurnia).
Visit Ranni's Rise to confirm what he suspects, then return to him.
He eventually dies at the Hold — his letter about D's brother feeds Fia's quest. Loot his gear.

warnings: Talk to him repeatedly — the "About D" line is needed for the final letter.

quests.name: Fia, the Deathbed Companion
quests.tagline: Leads to a hidden region, a dragon fight, and a mending-rune ending.
quests.reward: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince · unlocks the Age of the Duskborn ending

steps.text: At Roundtable Hold, accept her hug (Baldachin's Blessing temporarily lowers max HP while held — she lifts it later).
Progress Rogier's quest until she gives you the Weathered Dagger.
Give the dagger to D at the Hold, then reload the area.
Reach Deeproot Depths (via Nokron/Siofra, or the coffin past where Fia's room was) and beat Fia's Champions; tell her "I want to be held".
Get the Cursemark of Death from the Divine Tower of Liurnia (access comes via Ranni's quest) and give it to her; reload.
Enter her Deathbed Dream and beat Lichdragon Fortissax.
Take the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from her.

warnings: Refusing the first hug or skipping the dagger hand-off before progressing too far can strand her.

quests.name: D, Hunter of the Dead (+ his twin)
quests.tagline: Deathroot rewards, then a grim brother storyline.
quests.reward: Twinned Armor set · Inseparable Sword (via the brother)

steps.text: Meet D near Summonwater Village (N Limgrave) or at Roundtable Hold; he opens the way to Gurranq's Bestial Sanctum (Caelid) for Deathroot rewards.
D dies during Fia's quest (the Weathered Dagger step) — loot his Twinned Armor set from the side room.
Place the Twinned set on the sleeping twin in Nokron (near the Mimic Tear / Valiant Gargoyles area).
After Fia's quest resolves, find the twin over her body in Deeproot Depths — he leaves the Inseparable Sword and the set.

warnings: Don't kill D yourself for his armor — the brother turns hostile and you lose the peaceful payoff.

quests.name: Brother Corhyn & Goldmask
quests.tagline: The scholar's pilgrimage — ends in the Age of Order rune.
quests.reward: Mending Rune of Perfect Order · unlocks the Age of Order ending

steps.text: Talk to Corhyn at Roundtable Hold (he sells incantations). After you reach Altus Plateau, he leaves.
Find Corhyn near the Altus Highway grace; tell him Goldmask is the silent figure on the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.
Meet them again in Leyndell (near the Erdtree Sanctuary / colosseum).
Cast Law of Regression on the Radagon statue at the top of the lift past the Erdtree Sanctuary (you'll need INT 37 or a stat-boosting setup to cast it).
Follow them to the Mountaintops of the Giants; keep exhausting dialogue.
In the Ashen Capital (late game), collect the Mending Rune of Perfect Order from Goldmask.

warnings: The Law of Regression statue step is the one that actually matters for the rune — don't skip it.
Giving Corhyn the Tonic of Forgetfulness in the Mountaintops changes his outcome.

quests.name: Nepheli Loux (+ Kenneth Haight)
quests.tagline: A warrior finds her purpose — and Limgrave gets a ruler.
quests.reward: Arsenal Charm (more equip load) · Stormhawk Axe payoffs

steps.text: Summon or meet her in Stormveil Castle (gold sign vs Godrick), then talk to her at Roundtable Hold.
Help her at the Village of the Albinaurics (W Liurnia) against the Omenkiller, then talk at the Hold.
Give her The Stormhawk King ashes (found in the Chapel of Anticipation — revisitable later via Stormveil).
Clear Fort Haight for Kenneth Haight (E Limgrave) and follow his stops; he and Nepheli end up in Stormveil's throne room with her as ruler.

warnings: Giving her Seluvis's Potion turns her into a puppet and ends the quest.
Killing Gatekeeper Gostoc in Stormveil can also break the chain.

quests.name: Dung Eater
quests.tagline: The cursed one. A dark rune — or a Colossal Sword if you'd rather.
quests.reward: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse · alt: Sword of Milos

steps.text: He only appears at Roundtable Hold once you're carrying a Seedbed Curse. Show him one → Sewer-Gaol Key.
Free his body in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath Leyndell.
Beat his invasion at the Outer Wall Battleground (Leyndell), then return to the Hold.
Feed his corpse 5 Seedbed Curses (scattered on corpses in optional dungeons).
Take the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.

warnings: Invisible to you until you hold a Seedbed Curse — easy to miss entirely.
Alternative: kill him in the gaol for the Sword of Milos (restores FP on kills) — but that forfeits the rune.

quests.name: Gowry & Millicent
quests.tagline: The scarlet-rot pilgrimage — spans half the game, worth every stop.
quests.reward: Millicent's Prosthesis or Rotten Winged Sword Insignia · Unalloyed Gold Needle (Frenzied-Flame revert)

steps.text: Talk to Gowry at his shack (E of the Swamp of Aeonia, Caelid).
Beat Commander O'Neil in the swamp → Unalloyed Gold Needle → give it to Gowry to repair.
Take the repaired needle to Millicent at the Church of the Plague (NE Caelid); rest, return, talk until she revives.
Meet her at Gowry's Shack, then again at Erdtree-Gazing Hill (Altus).
Get the Valkyrie's Prosthesis from a chest in the Shaded Castle (NW Altus) and give it to her.
Meet her in the Mountaintops, then at the Prayer Room grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
At Elphael choose the gold sign (help her vs her sisters). Afterwards collect the needle and her talisman.

warnings: Talk to Gowry at Elphael before choosing a sign.
Each hand-off needs a rest/reload — don't skip beats.
The red sign (fight her) gives a different talisman and a darker outcome.

quests.name: Sorceress Sellen
quests.tagline: The outlaw sorcerer's conspiracy — sorcery rewards either way it ends.
quests.reward: Glintstone sorceries · endgame choice of rewards at the Grand Library

steps.text: Beat the Mad Pumpkin Head in the Waypoint Ruins cellar (E Limgrave) and pick "I wish to learn glintstone sorceries."
Find Primeval Sorcerer Azur past Hermit Village (Mt. Gelmir), then report to Sellen → Sellian Sealbreaker.
Free Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway (Caelid).
After beating Radahn, collect her Primal Glintstone at Witchbane Ruins (Weeping Peninsula).
Transplant it into the puppet in Seluvis's basement (Three Sisters, Liurnia).
Beat Rennala, talk to Jerren at Redmane Castle after Radahn, then meet him at Witchbane Ruins.
At the Raya Lucaria Grand Library, summon Sellen's gold sign and beat Witch-Hunter Jerren; her story concludes.

warnings: You MUST talk to Jerren at Redmane after Radahn, and beat Rennala first, or the finale never opens.
Ignoring the Sellen-vs-Jerren choice leaves her quest dead.

quests.name: Volcano Manor (Tanith & Rya)
quests.tagline: Join the Recusants — assassination contracts with real rewards.
quests.reward: Weapons/talismans per contract · Daedicar's Woe (Rya)

steps.text: Meet Rya at Scenic Isle (Liurnia); recover her necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart at Boilprawn Shack → Manor invitation. (Or just walk into Volcano Manor and read the letter in the drawing room.)
Join Lady Tanith's Recusants; take each target letter as it's offered.
Complete the hunts (Old Knight Istvan, Rileigh the Idle, the Godskin Noble, etc.), reporting back after each for rewards.
See Rya's story through — every choice at the end eventually yields Daedicar's Woe.

warnings: Beating Rykard closes ALL Manor business (Rya, Patches, Diallos, Tanith). Finish the letters first.

quests.name: Patches
quests.tagline: The recurring trickster. Spare him — it pays off for the rest of the game.
quests.reward: His shop, hint dialogue, Dancer's Castanets hand-off

steps.text: Fight him in Murkwater Cave (Limgrave); at ~half HP he yields — forgive him and he becomes a merchant.
Visit him at Scenic Isle (Liurnia) for hints.
Survive his cliff prank on Mt. Gelmir; he joins Volcano Manor — do his hunt (Great Horned Tragoth).
Find him wounded at the Shaded Castle → Dancer's Castanets (for Tanith).
Final (non-lethal) scuffle back at Murkwater Cave.

warnings: Don't kill him at the first ambush — you lose his shop and everything after.
Don't open his chest in Murkwater without asking — it teleports you away.

quests.name: Diallos of House Hoslow
quests.tagline: A knight looking for meaning; finds it guarding a village of jars.
quests.reward: Numen's Rune + Hoslow gear · access beats at the Manor

steps.text: Talk at Roundtable Hold (he's searching for Lanya).
Find him at Academy Gate Town (Liurnia), then return to the Hold — he names Volcano Manor.
See him in the Manor drawing room while doing the Recusant letters.
After Rykard falls he retires to Jarburg (E Liurnia); talk to him there.
Rest ~5 times / revisit over time → return for his final scene; collect the Numen's Rune and his gear.

warnings: The Jarburg finale is gated behind resting/elapsed visits — it won't pop immediately.

quests.name: White-Mask Varré
quests.tagline: The first NPC you meet — and the early shortcut to Mohg's palace.
quests.reward: Bloody Finger · Pureblood Knight's Medal (teleport to Mohgwyn Palace)

steps.text: Talk to him at The First Step (Limgrave), then find him at the Rose Church (W Liurnia) after beating Godrick and meeting the Two Fingers.
Answer "They didn't seem right" → receive 5 Festering Bloody Fingers.
Complete 3 invasions (they don't need to be wins).
Accept knighthood; soak the cloth in a maiden's blood (e.g. the Church of Inhibition or Stormveil chapel corpse).
Receive the Bloody Finger + Pureblood Knight's Medal — a free teleport to Mohgwyn Palace.
Optional end: invade and defeat Varré in Mohgwyn Palace.

warnings: Answering "magnificent" instead stalls the quest.
Mohgwyn Palace is a late-game zone — the medal is a shortcut, not an invitation to fight Mohg at level 40.

quests.name: Boc the Seamster
quests.tagline: The wholesome one. Free your tailor from a bush; keep him alive.
quests.reward: Free garment alteration all game

steps.text: Hit the talking bush near Gatefront Ruins (Limgrave) to free Boc.
Fetch his Sewing Needle from Coastal Cave (beat the Demi-Human Chiefs); with Tailoring Tools he alters armor at Lake-Facing Cliffs.
Bring him the Gold Sewing Needle from the Church of Vows for special alterations.
Follow him via Altus to Leyndell, East Capital Rampart.
Use the "You're Beautiful" Prattling Pate (Hermit Village, Mt. Gelmir) on him BEFORE his final request — he finds peace and lives.

warnings: Giving him a Larval Tear instead sends him to be reborn — he dies. Get the Prattling Pate first.

quests.name: Latenna the Albinauric
quests.tagline: Half a medallion each — she's your ticket to the secret snowfield.
quests.reward: Latenna Spirit Ash · Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.text: Get the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) from Albus — a disguised pot in the Village of the Albinaurics.
Show it to Latenna at Slumbering Wolf's Shack (via Lakeside Crystal Cave, W Liurnia); she joins you as a Spirit Ash.
Beat Commander Niall at Castle Sol (Mountaintops) for the Left half.
Use both halves at the Grand Lift of Rold → Consecrated Snowfield; summon her at the Apostate Derelict for the somber dragon stone.

warnings: Visit her BEFORE grabbing the Castle Sol half, or she's already dead when you arrive.

quests.name: Yura, Hunter of Bloody Fingers
quests.tagline: The bloody-finger hunter; his katana is a gift that lasts all game.
quests.reward: Nagakiba katana · Eleonora's Poleblade at his finale

steps.text: Meet him near Agheel Lake (Limgrave); beat the Bloody Finger Nerijus invasion in the ravine, then exhaust his dialogue → Nagakiba.
Answer his gold summon near the Raya Lucaria Main Gate vs the Ravenmount Assassin.
Visit the Second Church of Marika (Altus) — his confrontation with Eleonora plays out; loot her Poleblade.
His story concludes in the Mountaintops (Shabriri).

warnings: Reach the Second Church of Marika BEFORE entering the Mountaintops or the finale is skipped.

quests.name: Alexander, Iron Fist
quests.tagline: The warrior jar's pilgrimage — ends with a top-tier skill talisman.
quests.reward: Shard of Alexander (big skill-damage talisman) · Alexander's Innards

steps.text: Hit him from behind to pop him out of the hole in NE Limgrave (SW of Saintsbridge).
Meet him at Gael Tunnel (Caelid), then at the Radahn Festival (he's a summon for Radahn).
Free him from a second hole in Liurnia — throw an Oil Pot at him.
Find him bathing in lava on Mt. Gelmir → Jar helm.
Duel him in Crumbling Farum Azula → Shard of Alexander.

warnings: The Liurnia hole needs an Oil Pot (craftable — Melting Pot + oil).
Do the Farum Azula duel before beating Maliketh. (verify)

quests.name: Hyetta → the Frenzied Flame
quests.tagline: MAJOR commitment: this path locks you into an ending unless reverted.
quests.reward: Unlocks the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending

steps.text: Resolve Irina's request in the Weeping Peninsula first (Hyetta appears after; Irina must not die by your hand).

Meet Hyetta at Lake-Facing Cliffs; feed her Shabriri Grapes at each stop (Purified Ruins, Gate Town Bridge) — grapes are at Stormveil's rear, the Purified Ruins cellar, and on Edgar at Revenger's Shack.
At Bellum Church she asks for a Fingerprint Grape — beat Festering Fingerprint Vyke (Church of Inhibition).
After Morgott falls, find her at the Frenzied Flame Proscription deep in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Point of no return: remove ALL armor and enter the sealed door to inherit the Flame of Frenzy.

warnings: Opening that door locks the Frenzied Flame ending. It can only be undone later with Miquella's Needle (after beating Malenia, using Millicent's needle). (verify)
Don't open the door unless you mean it.

quests.name: Thops
quests.tagline: The broke scholar just wants to go back to school.
quests.reward: Thops's Barrier sorcery · Academy Glintstone Staff · his Bell Bearing

steps.text: Donate 10 runes at the Church of Irith (E Liurnia) to open his shop.
Bring him a SECOND Academy Glintstone Key (one sits on the dragon corpse atop Raya Lucaria; he refuses your first key).
Find him at the Schoolhouse Classroom grace inside the Academy; collect his sorcery, staff, and Bell Bearing.

warnings: Easy to forget — you need a spare academy key, not the one you used on the seal.
